dashboard.page.title: Dashboard
dashboard.page.sessionsText: See where you’re signed in and sign devices out.
dashboard.page.step.passkey.title: Log in in seconds
dashboard.page.step.passkey.text: With a passkey you no longer need an email link – your fingerprint or face is enough.
dashboard.page.step.profile.title: Complete your profile
dashboard.page.step.profile.text: Your name and contact details help your team reach you for pickups.
dashboard.page.step.activity.title: Keep track
dashboard.page.step.activity.text: See what happened in your account – with the time and who did it.
dashboard.page.roleHint.FOODSHARER: As a foodsharer you share food. The quiz and intro pickups make you a foodsaver.
dashboard.page.roleHint.FOODSAVER: As a foodsaver you pick up food from businesses and pass it on.
dashboard.page.roleHint.STORE_MANAGER: As a store manager you coordinate the pickups and the team of your stores.
dashboard.page.roleHint.AMBASSADOR: As an ambassador you look after your region and help new foodsavers get started.
dashboard.page.roleHint.ORGA: As part of the orga team you have access to all regions and the platform administration.
dashboard.page.admin.title: Administration
dashboard.page.admin.text: Soon you’ll manage your region’s members, verification and newcomers right here.
